พ.ศ. 2511 มีการนำเหล็กจากเรือขุดแร่มาสร้: In 1968 (พ.ศ. 2511), steel from a mining dredger was used to build the more than 200-metre Khok Khanun Iron Bridge across the Takua Pa River. The project was initiated by Juti Boonsung, owner of Juti Boonsung Mining Dredger Co., Ltd., which he founded in 1960 (พ.ศ. 2503).
สะพานทอดข้ามแม่น้ำตะกั่วป่าและเชื่อมพื้น: The bridge crosses the Takua Pa River, linking the main road area with the former mining plant. It uses steel from a decommissioned mining dredger, and the old plant is still visible at the far end. From the bridge, you can see green fields, trees, and mountain ranges, making it suitable for views and photography.

หลักฐานท้องถิ่นระบุว่าบ้านขุนอินทร์สร้าง: Local evidence indicates that Khun In House was built around 1917 (พ.ศ. 2460) by Chinese craftsmen as the residence of Captain Khun Intharakhiri (Choi Na Nakhon), a descendant of the town's hereditary governors who later served as Takua Pa district chief between 1921·1926 (พ.ศ. 2464·2469). It was therefore more than a beautiful building: it was the home of a person involved in the town's shift from hereditary rule to the district system.
บ้านหลังนี้เกิดขึ้นในเมืองตะกั่วป่าที่เต: The house emerged in Takua Pa as the town grew through trade and tin mining. Rivers and canals served as transport routes, trading boats from China and Burma exchanged goods, and many Thai people of Chinese and Hokkien Chinese descent settled here. Its two-storey adapted Sino-Portuguese brick-and-mortar architecture reflects both the owner's status and the Andaman trading world that connected Takua Pa with people of many cultures.
ในเมืองตอนนั้น บ้านทำหน้าที่เป็นที่อยู่อ: At that time, the house served as a residence for a senior official and formed part of an old-town landscape of merchant homes, shops, and religious sites. However, no primary document has been found that directly records its construction date, the craftsmen's names, or any other public function of the house.
หลังใช้งานมาหลายทศวรรษ อาคารชำรุดทรุดโทร: After several decades of use, the building deteriorated. The Na Nakhon family repaired it around 1981 (พ.ศ. 2524), largely retaining its original form and replacing turtle-back roof tiles with corrugated tiles. Among accessible sources, this is the conservation event for Khun In House with the clearest year.
ระหว่างนั้น เมืองตะกั่วป่าเปลี่ยนจากศูนย: Meanwhile, Takua Pa changed from a mining and water-trade centre into a quieter town as its former economy declined. Rivers and canals became shallow due to mining activity, and the old community gradually took on a cultural and tourism role. Khun In House is therefore remembered alongside the cultural street, Chinese-European buildings, and evidence of the former mining town.
แหล่งทางการของ ONEP จัดบ้านขุนอินทร์เป็น: ONEP's official sources classify Khun In House as an architectural art site, while the SAC community database lists it among Takua Pa's historical sites. However, a review of accessible sources found no year confirming registration as a Fine Arts Department historic site, no record of use for another business, and no evidence that the house was damaged by the 2004 tsunami (พ.ศ. 2547).
สถานะที่ยืนยันได้ในปี 2569 คือบ้านขุนอิน: The status verified in 2026 (พ.ศ. 2569) is that Khun In House continues to be described as a historic building in Takua Pa old town. Local sources state that it remains under the care of the Na Nakhon family. The building's value lies in its adapted Sino-Portuguese style and its historical link to Khun Intharakhiri.
บ้านไม่ได้มีข้อมูลสาธารณะที่ยืนยันเวลาเป: The house has no public information verifying opening hours, admission fees, an on-site caretaker, or official access to the interior. It should therefore be treated as a building that can be viewed in its external context, while interior access remains unknown. It should not be described as a museum or a regular event venue.
ปัจจุบันบ้านทำหน้าที่เชิงสัญลักษณ์ในภูมิ: Today, the house serves a symbolic role in the old-town landscape alongside the community's cultural street and other historic buildings. Unlike projects with clear announcements, no news or announcement from 2022·2026 (พ.ศ. 2565·2569) has been found describing restoration or activities specific to Khun In House.
ช่วง พ.ศ. 2464·2469 บ้านเชื่อมโยงกับบุคค: During 1921·1926 (พ.ศ. 2464·2469), the house was linked to a person who served as Takua Pa district chief
เป็นบ้านพักอาศัยของ ร.อ.ท. ขุนอินทรคีรี: It was the residence of Captain Khun Intharakhiri (Choi Na Nakhon). Community tourism sources classify Khun In House among Takua Pa's historic sites and old buildings.
รูปทรงอาคารสองชั้นเป็นองค์ประกอบที่เห็นไ: Its two-storey form is visible from outside. Its adapted Sino-Portuguese style blends Western and Eastern art, and it was the residence of a notable person named in the ONEP database.
